19 internal call sites; exposing constant offsets saves 144 executable bytes
full 32-bit restoring division for unsigned /10 and %10; values proven below 100 allow removing one modulo loop, saving 28 bytes

limits: Size comparison uses the existing hash-bound original Workbench receipt; original image is unavailable on this host, so no fresh original disassembly or guest replay.
Existing shipping entry vector fixture models DOS parsers and I/O; all experiments preserve its observations, but this is not full Workbench parity.
No Execute ? continuation, short writes, read faults, close faults, work-file reopen faults, capacity boundaries, Ctrl-C/Ctrl-D, or truly interleaved resident invocation coverage in this fixture.
Cases reuse the loaded image with separate fixture instances; nested script concatenation is covered, overlapping continuations are not.
MorphOS host adapter is not reachable from the shipping entry and has no PPC size comparison here.
CopperScreen and original-image checks unavailable; out/C/Execute is unchanged.
Stack is peak observed A7 at instruction boundaries; instruction counts exclude execution inside real DOS/Exec library implementations.
